Definition: a nettle (as stinging like a burn)
BiblicalUsage: In Isaiah we find çarpâd, the word for a nettle. Plainly used, and no mystery about what it means.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çarpâd is worth a moment of attention, and I think you will see why when you read the verse.
